title: tests(scripts): harden docs-site fallback mirror guard with source parity

reviewers.text:
Verdict: CHANGES-REQUESTED
- [P2] tests/scripts/test_docs_site_sync_links.py:163: subprocess.run invokes `node sync-docs.js` in a stripped tmp tree (only docs/ + scripts/ + a few ../ sources copied); missing node_modules/deps will cause runtime failures or silent partial syncs.
- [P2] tests/scripts/test_docs_site_sync_links.py:145: root_source_files logic only handles entries starting with "../"; any DOC_MAP entry using a different relative form will be omitted from the temp workspace and produce false mismatches.
- [P2] tests/scripts/test_docs_site_sync_links.py:128: new test now requires Node.js + sync-docs.js runtime in the test env (previously absent), introducing an undeclared CI dependency and potential flakiness.

Verdict: PASS

- [P3] `test_docs_site_sync_fallback_mirror_pages_match_source_content`: The `subprocess.run` call discards stdout/stderr unless there's a failure. Consider capturing and logging these in debug mode for troubleshooting. Location: line ~170.

title: feat(scripts): add OpenRouter fallback for Fable goal cycles

reviewers.text:
Verdict: CHANGES-REQUESTED

- [P2] scripts/fable_goal_cycle.py:538: run_consult computes overall_timeout as `timeout * (2 + int(openrouter_fallback))`, ignoring api_fallback, fallback_model, or _planned_attempt_count, causing under/over-budgeting and potential hangs/timeouts.
- [P2] scripts/consult_claude.py:545: cli_prompt = _compose_prompt(...) is now used only for CLI paths while raw prompt+system is passed to _run_api/_run_openrouter_api; this alters prior uniform composition and risks prompt duplication or system-instruction loss on CLI.
- [P3] scripts/consult_claude.py:366: _run_openrouter_api performs no request-size or token validation before sending (unlike response checks), allowing oversized payloads to OPENROUTER_API_URL.

Verdict: PASS

- [P3] `scripts/consult_claude.py` L369: `_run_api` now passes `system=system` where it previously passed `system=None`; this is a behavioral change that could affect API behavior if the Anthropic API treats `None` and `""` differently for system prompts. Verify with Anthropic API docs or tests.
- [P3] `scripts/consult_claude.py` L54: The docstring example for `--openrouter-fallback` could clarify that it's only used after *both* CLI and API attempts fail (not just CLI).
- [P3] `scripts/consult_claude.py` L685: The `--openrouter-model` help text could mention that the default is configurable via `ARAGORA_CONSULT_OPENROUTER_MODEL` or `OPENROUTER_FABLE_MODEL` for clarity.

title: fix(routing): handle empty LLM domain responses

reviewers.text:
Verdict: CHANGES-REQUESTED
- [P2] domain_matcher.py:477: _detect_with_llm now returns None (new empty-content path + changed invalid-text path) but is annotated `-> list[tuple[str, float]]`, risking type errors or unhandled None at callers
- [P2] tests/routing/test_domain_matcher_root.py:30: removal of anthropic.types monkey-patch may regress other tests that relied on the real TextBlock shape rather than SimpleNamespace

Verdict: CHANGES-REQUESTED

- [P1] `aragora/routing/domain_matcher.py` line 482: Returning `None` on empty content breaks the caller’s expectation of a list; the existing fallback logic in `detect()` will crash when it tries to iterate over `None`. Revert to `return []`.
- [P2] `aragora/routing/domain_matcher.py` line 488: Same issue—returning `None` instead of `[]` risks a regression in the caller.
- [P3] `tests/routing/test_domain_matcher_root.py` lines 15–21: Removed the `anthropic` module mock setup, but the test suite still relies on it elsewhere; this may cause unrelated tests to fail if they run after this one. Either restore the mock or ensure all tests are isolated.
